description: Bande de recul du trait de côte du littoral rocheux aquitain 2050 suite à un évènement tempétueux majeur (Lmax 2050) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Maximum retreat zone of the Aquitaine rocky coastline in 2050 following a major tempestuous event (Lmax 2050). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline retreat band of the Aquitaine rocky coastline 2050 following a major tempestuous event (Lmax 2050)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte prospectif, géomorphologie, Lmax, littoral aquitain, côte rocheuse, littoral_oca. The listing shows 2016-07-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
